'''Ion grenades''' were hand [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] that disrupted electronics similar to [[Electromagnetic pulse grenade/Legends|EMP grenades]].

==Description==
Ion grenades discharged an electromagnetic pulse that disabled any electronic devices such as [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[Autoturret/Legends|automated turrets]], vehicles,<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" /> and personal [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]],.<ref name="KOTOR 2 Prima Official Guide">[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref> An ion grenade was designed to explode on contact after it was thrown, triggering an ion burst with a three [[Meter/Legends|meter]] blast radius.<ref name="Saga Edition Core Rulebook" />

==History==
Around [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] in the [[Old Republic era]], [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Meetra Surik]] used ion grenades on their travels. Some [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith troopers]] also used them.

Ion grenades were also used around the time of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="SW:OW">[[Star Wars: Obi-Wan: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: Obi-Wan'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref> They were later used by certain [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] such as [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]] and [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]].<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide" />
